root_cause.text: A race in the RDMA/mlx5 LAG teardown path was introduced by registering the mlx5_ib sys_error notifier only after IB device registration and removing it too early, so the bonded master mlx5_ib_dev could miss slave MLX5_DEV_EVENT_SYS_ERROR notifications during firmware reset and keep posting UMRs whose completions never arrive.
root_cause.evidence: The commit explicitly says “In LAG mode the bond device is only registered on the master, so it never sees sys_error events from the slave,” and fixes it by adding a dedicated sys_error notifier “registered before MLX5_IB_STAGE_IB_REG and stays alive until after ib_unregister_device()”; it also references the regressing commit “Fixes: ede132a5cf55 (‘RDMA/mlx5: Move events notifier registration to be after device registration’).”

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove an unused local `fatal` variable from `mlx5_ib_handle_event()` to clean up the function without changing behavior.
intent_record.what: The local variable declaration `bool fatal = false;` was removed from `mlx5_ib_handle_event()` while the surrounding code remained unchanged in this diff hunk.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this change has no effect if the variable was unused, and it eliminates an unnecessary local declaration from the function.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove SYS_ERROR handling from mlx5_ib_handle_event() so fatal device events are no longer processed through this event-switch path.
intent_record.what: The switch case handling MLX5_DEV_EVENT_SYS_ERROR was removed from mlx5_ib_handle_event(), including the assignment of IB_EVENT_DEVICE_FATAL, the call to mlx5_ib_handle_internal_error(ibdev), setting ibev.element.port_num from work->param, setting fatal = true, and the terminating break.
intent_record.how: At runtime, mlx5_ib_handle_event() no longer processes MLX5_DEV_EVENT_SYS_ERROR events in this switch, so it will no longer generate an IB_EVENT_DEVICE_FATAL notification or invoke the internal error handler from this path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Stop fatal event handling from clearing ibdev->ib_active so the device is not incorrectly left inactive.
intent_record.what: The diff removes a two-line conditional block from mlx5_ib_handle_event() that set ibdev->ib_active to false when the local variable fatal was true.
intent_record.how: After this change, handling a fatal event no longer deactivates the InfiniBand device by clearing ibdev->ib_active, so the device remains marked active and subsequent event dispatch eligibility based on this flag is no longer permanently disabled by this path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add mlx5 IB notifier-based handling for core system error events so fatal device errors trigger internal recovery, notify RDMA users, and deactivate the IB device.
intent_record.what: The patch adds a new asynchronous system-error event handling path by introducing four functions: a workqueue callback `mlx5_ib_handle_sys_error_event()`, a notifier callback `mlx5_ib_sys_error_event()`, and notifier init/cleanup helpers `mlx5_ib_stage_sys_error_notifier_init()` and `mlx5_ib_stage_sys_error_notifier_cleanup()`. The notifier filters for `MLX5_DEV_EVENT_SYS_ERROR`, allocates `mlx5_ib_event_work`, initializes it, and queues it on `mlx5_ib_event_wq`. The work handler sets up an `ib_event` with `IB_EVENT_DEVICE_FATAL`, calls `mlx5_ib_handle_internal_error()`, copies the port from `work->param`, validates the port with `rdma_is_port_valid()`, dispatches the event if `ibdev->ib_active` is true, then sets `ibdev->ib_active` to false and frees the work item. The init/cleanup helpers register and unregister the notifier with `mlx5_notifier_register()` and `mlx5_notifier_unregister()`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the driver now listens for device-level system error notifications from the mlx5 core and processes them asynchronously in a workqueue context instead of ignoring them. When a system error occurs, it triggers internal error handling, emits an RDMA `IB_EVENT_DEVICE_FATAL` event for a valid port if the IB device is still active, and then marks the IB device inactive to prevent further normal operation after the fatal condition.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a PF profile lifecycle stage to initialize and clean up the system error notifier during device bring-up and teardown.
intent_record.what: A new initialization/cleanup stage named MLX5_IB_STAGE_SYS_ERROR_NOTIFIER was added to the pf_profile stage list, using mlx5_ib_stage_sys_error_notifier_init and mlx5_ib_stage_sys_error_notifier_cleanup, and placed between the existing MLX5_IB_STAGE_WHITELIST_UID and MLX5_IB_STAGE_IB_REG stages.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the pf_profile initialization sequence now registers a system error notifier stage during device setup and invokes its corresponding cleanup during teardown, enabling system error notification handling as part of the PF device lifecycle.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add the system error notifier stage to raw_eth_profile initialization so system error handling is properly registered and cleaned up.
intent_record.what: A new initialization stage, MLX5_IB_STAGE_SYS_ERROR_NOTIFIER, was added to the raw_eth_profile stage table using STAGE_CREATE, with mlx5_ib_stage_sys_error_notifier_init as its init function and mlx5_ib_stage_sys_error_notifier_cleanup as its cleanup function, inserted between the existing MLX5_IB_STAGE_WHITELIST_UID and MLX5_IB_STAGE_IB_REG stages.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the raw_eth_profile device setup sequence now registers a system error notifier stage during initialization and invokes its corresponding cleanup during teardown or rollback, enabling system error notification handling for this profile as part of the managed stage lifecycle.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a dedicated staged initialization enum entry for the system error notifier so it can be ordered within the mlx5_ib device setup and teardown flow.
intent_record.what: A new enum constant, MLX5_IB_STAGE_SYS_ERROR_NOTIFIER, was inserted into the mlx5_ib_stages enumeration between MLX5_IB_STAGE_WHITELIST_UID and MLX5_IB_STAGE_IB_REG.
intent_record.how: This adds a distinct initialization/cleanup stage identifier for a system error notifier in the driver's staged setup flow, enabling code elsewhere to register and unwind that notifier at a specific ordered point in the device lifecycle.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a notifier_block field to mlx5_ib_dev for system error event notifications.
intent_record.what: A new field named sys_error_events of type struct notifier_block was added to struct mlx5_ib_dev between the existing mdev_events and lag_events notifier_block members.
intent_record.how: This extends the mlx5_ib_dev device state to hold a separate notifier registration block for system error event handling, enabling related code to track or register a callback for those events at runtime.

consistency_review.core_intent: Refactor mlx5_ib system error handling to use a dedicated notifier integrated into device initialization and teardown instead of the generic event switch path.
Implement and wire up IB/core system error notifier handling so fatal device errors are propagated and managed correctly during initialization and runtime.

relevance_review.reason: This change only removes an unused local variable for cleanup and does not affect notifier registration/removal timing, LAG teardown, sys_error event handling, or the firmware reset race at the root of the vulnerability.
